# CleanShield (净盾) — Stop Shake-Ads, Hidden Ad Profiling & Web Trackers

> 100% Offline iOS Safari Content Blocker + 6-Brand Phone Ad/Privacy Switch Navigator (Apple iOS, Xiaomi HyperOS, Huawei HarmonyOS, OPPO ColorOS, vivo OriginOS, Honor MagicOS) + Local Photo GPS/EXIF Scrubber.

## Key Capabilities
- **6-Brand System Ad & Shake-Jump Opt-Out Guide**: Exact menu paths to revoke motion/gyroscope sensor triggers ("shake-to-jump" splash ads) and disable system-level ad personalization across iPhone, Xiaomi, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, and Honor.
- **Top 30 App Hidden Ad Switch Audit + 180-Day Reset Alerts**: Step-by-step instructions to turn off behavioral ad targeting in WeChat (including its 6-month silent auto-reset), Taobao, Douyin, Baidu Netdisk, Weibo, Meituan, and more.
- **Zero-Permission Safari Shield (iOS)**: Declarative WebKit `SFContentBlocker` with a 26-domain safe whitelist (Maps, Banking, Carriers, Payments) so essential apps never break and Safari never triggers scary password-read warnings.
- **100% Local Photo EXIF/GPS Scrubber**: Strip hidden home coordinates and camera metadata before sharing original photos.
